title: Forwarded domain event v1 (server -> client)
description: A domain event pushed to the users it concerns: offers and wallet changes to the driver, trip changes to the customer and the assigned driver, payments and refunds to the customer. type is the event type in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (DriverOfferCreated -> DRIVER_OFFER_CREATED), version is the eventVersion, messageId is the eventId, aggregateVersion and correlationId are those of the event, and data is the event payload exactly as in contracts/events/<EventType>.v<version>.schema.json.
